description: Generate a slide-deck-quality chevron process diagram: 2–7 phases drawn as arrow-shaped chevrons left to right, each with an optional timing line ("Weeks 1–2") and up to 5 short bullets beneath it, and an optional "you are here" highlight on one phase. Choose it for an "our approach" or methodology slide, delivery phases, a sales or onboarding process, or any short linear sequence where the ORDER of the phases matters; use a timeline instead when exact dates and overlapping durations matter, a cycle diagram when the last step loops back to the first, and an org chart or mind map for branching structures. Limits: 2–7 steps, up to 5 bullets per step; keep step names to one to three words and bullets to a short phrase. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

inputSchema.description: A chevron process diagram: 2–7 phases as chevrons left to right, with optional timing and bullets under each.

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

current.description: Optional highlight: the 0-based index of one step (0 is the first step). A pointer with a label (currentLabel, default "You are here") appears above that step; every step keeps its colour. Omit for no highlight (the default).

currentLabel.description: Text above the pointer on the highlighted step (only shown when current is set). Default "You are here"; e.g. "We are here", "Today", "Current phase".

palette.description: Hex colours applied in order to items that have no colour of their own. Pass the user's brand colours here when they name them. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

steps.description: The phases, left to right (2–7; extra steps are dropped with a warning). Each step is one chevron with its name inside, an optional timing line just under it and optional bullets beneath. Keep names to one to three words; long names shrink, wrap to two lines, then truncate.

bullets.description: Optional detail points listed under the chevron (up to 5). Short phrases work best; long ones wrap onto several lines.

color.description: Hex colour for this chevron, e.g. "#4f46e5". Optional: steps without one take the next palette colour. Text inside switches between white and dark for contrast.

name.description: Phase name shown inside the chevron, e.g. "Discover". Shrinks from 15px to 11px, then wraps to two lines, then truncates.

timing.description: Optional short timing line shown under the chevron, e.g. "Weeks 1–2", "Q3" or "30 days". Omit for none.

title.description: Heading shown top-left of the chart at 22px bold. Every chart has one title row; an empty string hides it.

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400, default 1280, which suits a 16:9 slide). PNG output renders at 2x. Height is computed from the content.
